domain: general (adapt to the actual corpus before extracting)
_note: A neutral starting point. Delete types that don't appear in the documents, and add domain-specific ones. Do NOT extract against this verbatim — a schema that doesn't match the corpus produces a graph that doesn't either.

entity_types.description: A company, agency, institution, or formal group.
A place: city, country, region, address, or facility.
A named product, service, system, or work.
A discrete happening with a name or clear identity (deal, launch, incident).
A defined idea, method, or topic that is a subject of discussion.

relationship_types.description: Person works or worked for the organization.
Entity is situated in a place.
Source is a component or member of target.
Two organizations in a stated partnership.
Organization or person created the product/work.
Entity took part in the event.
Last-resort generic link; FLAG for review and replace with a specific type whenever possible.
